scientific_integrity: The exact two-by-two signed Bernoulli distribution and sharp extrema are proved by explicit enumeration and analytic optimization; ordinary symbolic and dense-matrix numerical checks have been performed. This is neither an independently audited theorem nor an implementation-level floating-point guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Independent unbiased unit-grid entry rounding, a scaled real planar rotation in the closed unit cell excluding the zero input for relative ratios, and squared least singular values. The angle-bifurcation classification assumes norm at most one; no high-dimensional or adaptive quantization claim is made. Mathematical priority is subject to outside confirmation.
title: Sharp least-singular-value loss under stochastic rounding of planar rotations
